svg.title: Antigone, veiled, her hands bound behind her back, her head bowed
svg.desc: Line drawing after the Apulian red-figure amphora by the Darius Painter, c. 350-320 BCE, Berlin, Antikensammlung F 3240; traced from a photograph by ArchaiOptix (CC BY-SA 4.0), changed: taken off the vase's curve, mended breaks erased, and her hands and face redrawn. This drawing is CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). Photograph: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Darius_Painter_-_RVAp_18-23_-_Antigone_-_judgement_of_Paris_-_Eros_with_youths_and_women_-_Berlin_AS_F_3240_-_04.jpg
